description: This file defines functional options for configuring a JWT parser, including validation settings, JSON parsing options, and decoding modes.

methods.name: WithValidMethods
methods.description: Sets allowed algorithm methods for JWT validation to prevent vulnerabilities.

methods.name: WithJSONNumber
methods.description: Configures JSON parser to use number decoding.

methods.name: WithoutClaimsValidation
methods.description: Disables claims validation, use with caution.

methods.name: WithLeeway
methods.description: Sets leeway duration for time-based claims validation.

methods.name: WithTimeFunc
methods.description: Provides custom time function, mainly for testing.

methods.name: WithStrictDecoding
methods.description: Enforces strict decoding mode for JWTs.
